privacy.title: Privacy and your data
privacy.staysBody: No account, no ads, no tracking. What you write and choose in Wafi is kept on this phone only, and nobody else can see it, us included.
privacy.leavesTitle: It only leaves when you choose
privacy.leavesBody: When you send a kind word or export your data, your phone's share menu passes it to the app you pick. Wafi never sends anything by itself.
privacy.backupBody: If backup is turned on in your phone's settings, Android can include Wafi in it, in your own Google account. We can't see it.
privacy.notificationsBody: Wafi kind words are planned and sent by your phone itself, with no server in between.
privacy.deleteHelp: Erases your notes, events, favorites, settings and everything else Wafi keeps on this phone, straight away.
privacy.deleteConfirmMessage: Everything Wafi keeps on this phone will be erased, including your notes. This can't be undone. To keep a copy, export your data first.
privacy.exportHelp: Keep a copy of your notes, events, favorites and settings in a file, wherever you like: your email, a cloud drive, a message to yourself. On a new phone, import it to bring everything back.

deliveryHelp.title: If Wafi kind words arrive late
deliveryHelp.intro: To save battery, some phones hold back apps' notifications, so Wafi kind words can come late, or not at all. These settings can help. None of them is required.
deliveryHelp.exactBody: "Alarms & reminders" lets Wafi send each kind word right at the time you chose. If it's off, Android may send them a little later.
deliveryHelp.batteryBody: In Wafi's settings, set battery use to "Unrestricted" (on some phones: "Don't optimize").
deliveryHelp.notificationsBody: Check that notifications are allowed for Wafi, including the "Wafi kind words" category.
deliveryHelp.brandsTitle: Some phones need one more step

brands.samsung: Samsung: Settings > Battery > Background usage limits > Never sleeping apps, then add Wafi.
brands.xiaomi: Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO: turn on Autostart for Wafi, and set its battery saver to "No restrictions".
brands.huawei: Huawei, Honor: Settings > Battery > App launch, turn off "Manage automatically" for Wafi and leave everything on.
brands.other: Other phones: look for Wafi in the battery settings and turn off battery optimization.

deliveryHelp.footer: Wafi keeps working either way: its kind words may just arrive a little late.
